import pixeltable as pxt

# Define profit computation as UDF
@pxt.udf
def compute_profit(revenue: float, budget: float) -> float:
    return revenue - budget

# Access the films table
films = pxt.get_table('films')

# Add computed column to the table
films.add_column(compute_profit(films.revenue, films.budget), name='profit')
